sub_questions: Does the SBOM record the author (person/organization) who created the SBOM data?
XBOM-1.remediation_guidance: Configure the SBOM generation process/tool to record the SBOM author.

sub_questions: Is a cryptographic signature attributable to the SBOM author applied to attest authenticity?
XBOM-2.remediation_guidance: Sign SBOMs with a cryptographic signature attributable to the author to attest authenticity.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM identify the data format standard used (CycloneDX, SPDX)?
XBOM-3.remediation_guidance: Ensure SBOMs explicitly identify the format standard they are expressed in.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM record the specific format version, and is it a current/non-deprecated version?
XBOM-4.remediation_guidance: Record the format version used and keep it on a current, non-deprecated version of CycloneDX/SPDX.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM record the lifecycle phase (design, build, post-build) at which it was generated?
XBOM-5.remediation_guidance: Configure SBOM generation to record the lifecycle phase of production.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM record a timestamp of its most recent update?
XBOM-6.remediation_guidance: Ensure SBOM generation stamps each document with the update timestamp.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM carry a unique version identifier distinguishing it from prior revisions?
XBOM-7.remediation_guidance: Assign a unique version identifier to each SBOM revision.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM record the name of the tool used to generate it?
XBOM-8.remediation_guidance: Ensure the SBOM generation tool records its own name in the output.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM record the version of the generation tool used?
XBOM-9.remediation_guidance: Ensure the SBOM generation tool records its own version in the output.

sub_questions: Does every component entry record a producer-assigned, human-readable name?
XBOM-10.remediation_guidance: Verify every component in the SBOM has its producer-assigned name recorded.

sub_questions: Does every component entry record its release/build version?
XBOM-11.remediation_guidance: Verify every component in the SBOM has its version recorded.

sub_questions: Does every component entry record its producer/supplier organization?
XBOM-12.remediation_guidance: Verify every component in the SBOM has its producer/supplier recorded.

sub_questions: Does every component carry a standard identifier (PURL, CPE, or equivalent) for automated lookups?
XBOM-13.remediation_guidance: Ensure components carry a standard identifier (PURL/CPE) enabling automated vulnerability correlation.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM document dependency relationships, including transitive/nested dependencies?
XBOM-14.remediation_guidance: Configure SBOM generation to capture full dependency trees, not only direct dependencies.

sub_questions: Does every component entry include a cryptographic hash of the actual artifact contents?
XBOM-15.remediation_guidance: Ensure components include a cryptographic hash value for integrity verification.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM record which hash algorithm was used for each component's hash value?
XBOM-16.remediation_guidance: Record the hash algorithm (e.g. SHA-256) used alongside each component's hash value.

sub_questions: Does every component entry record applicable license information?
XBOM-17.remediation_guidance: Ensure license information (SPDX license ID, URL, or descriptor) is recorded per component.

sub_questions: Does the SBOM generation process inventory the full dependency tree, not just direct dependencies?
XBOM-18.remediation_guidance: Adopt tooling/process ensuring full (including transitive) dependency coverage in SBOM generation.

sub_questions: Does the process mark unknown/withheld fields explicitly rather than leaving them blank?
XBOM-19.remediation_guidance: Configure SBOM generation to explicitly mark unknown, redacted, or not-applicable fields.

sub_questions: Are SBOMs produced/delivered in a standardized, machine-parsable format (SPDX/CycloneDX)?
XBOM-20.remediation_guidance: Standardize SBOM production and delivery on a machine-processable format (SPDX or CycloneDX).

sub_questions: Is there a documented process to issue corrected SBOMs promptly when errors are found?
XBOM-21.remediation_guidance: Establish a process for issuing corrected SBOMs with updated version/timestamp when errors are identified.

sub_questions: Is a new SBOM generated for each product/software release?
XBOM-22.remediation_guidance: Regenerate SBOMs for every product release rather than relying on a stale, one-time SBOM.

sub_questions: Are SBOMs distributed promptly to authorized parties without unnecessary access barriers?
XBOM-23.remediation_guidance: Establish a timely SBOM distribution process to authorized internal/external parties.
